name: Alexa Grasso
profileSummary: Karen Alexa Grasso Montes is a Mexican professional mixed martial artist who currently competes in the women's Flyweight division of the Ultimate Fighting Championship (UFC), where she is the former UFC Women's Flyweight Champion. Grasso is the first Mexican female fighter to win a UFC championship. She is also a UFC analyst for UFC Español for Spanish broadcasts. As of February 3, 2026, she is #3 in the Meta UFC women's flyweight rankings and as of March 31, 2026, she is #7 in the UFC women's pound-for-pound rankings.
